import json, os, urllib.parse, urllib.request
required = ("ACCEPTANCE_CONSULTATION_URL", "ACCEPTANCE_CONSULTATION_TOKEN", "ACCEPTANCE_TENANT_ID", "ACCEPTANCE_MEETING_ID")
if any(not os.environ.get(key, "").strip() for key in required):
    print("skipped: consultation read-only probe configuration missing")
    raise SystemExit(77)
base, token, tenant, meeting_id = (os.environ[key] for key in required)
path = "/api/consult/meetings/" + urllib.parse.quote(meeting_id, safe="")
request = urllib.request.Request(base.rstrip("/") + path, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "X-Tenant-Id": tenant, "X-Pantheon-Tenant-Id": tenant}, method="GET")
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
        meeting = json.load(response)
    assert meeting.get("tenant_id") == tenant
    assert meeting.get("status") == "closed"
    assert (meeting.get("execution_state") or {}).get("status") == "completed"
    assert meeting.get("round", 0) >= 2 and len(meeting.get("rounds") or []) >= 2
    assert meeting.get("outcome") in {"proposals_issued", "completed_no_proposal", "no_testable_hypothesis"}
    assert not meeting.get("memory_read_refusals")
    assert not meeting.get("rejected_positions")
    assert (meeting.get("minutes") or {}).get("institutional_entry_id")
    assert len(meeting.get("writebacks") or []) == len(meeting.get("participants") or []) > 0
    assert all(row.get("entry_id") for row in meeting["writebacks"])
except Exception as error:
    print("failed: " + type(error).__name__)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("passed: automatic meeting closed with completed workflow, rounds and recorded memory writebacks")
